question: What eightfold division is sought to be known fully and endlessly?
premises: An eightfold division is the object of inquiry
Complete knowledge of this division is desired
The knowledge is sought without limit
inference: The eightfold division is sought to be known fully and endlessly
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eightfold division is not specified in this verse
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division of the eightfold groups.
